{{Top}}
[[File:IFT-T.jpg|thumb|right|220px|An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TX-130T fighter tank|IFT-T hovertank]]]]
A '''hovertank''' or '''repulsortank''' was a type of [[Tank/Legends|tank]] that ran on [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]], and was usually more heavily armed and armored than a combat [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]]. Hovertanks could be outfitted with [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]], like the [[T1-B hovertank]].

==History==
[[File:T1-B.jpg|thumb|left|220px|The Rebel Alliance's T1-B hovertank was equipped with deflector shields.]]

===Clone Wars===
Depending on the model, some hovertanks were relatively fast and agile, such as the [[TX-130 Saber-class fighter tank/Legends|TX-130 ''Saber''-class fighter tank]] employed by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and the [[Ground Armored Tank]] used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="Clone Wars game">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' video game]]</ref> while others were much larger and sluggish, but very powerful, such as the [[Dreadnought battle tank]].

===Galactic Civil War===
Models used during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] included the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[2-M Saber-class repulsor tank/Legends|2-M Saber-class repulsor tank]],<ref name="EAW">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''</ref> the [[TX-130T fighter tank]],<ref name="Battlefront">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]''</ref> and the [[HAVr A9 Floating Fortress/Legends|HAVr A9 Floating Fortress]].<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook (Second Edition)">[[Imperial Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''Imperial Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] also maintained several hovertanks in their [[Alliance Army/Legends|army]], including the [[T1-B hovertank]]<ref name="ForceCommander">''[[Star Wars: Force Commander]]''</ref> and the [[AAC-1 speeder tank]].<ref name="Battlefront2">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>

[[Zel Johans|Colonel Zel Johans]], commanding officer of the [[Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit/Legends|Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit]] known colloquially as the [[Chaos/Legends|Hell's]] Hammers, was instrumental in the development of the repulsortank and its deployment tactics in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].
